en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large brick institutional complex with multiple connected buildings and steep, hipped roofs, partly hidden behind a line of trees and hedges. The lower part of the card is blank for writing. Printed red captions identify the scene as the garrison hospital in Borna, and small printer's details appear at the bottom left. A handwritten red number appears in the upper right corner.
